news.headline: Jefferson says decision on Vikings starting QB 'coach's call'
news.description: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson plans to continue working with both of his potential starting QBs during their upcoming summer break, but indicated he is unlikely to weigh in on the final decision between newcomer Kyler Murray and incumbent J.J. McCarthy.

news.headline: WR Jalen Coker, Panthers reach 3-year, $35M extension
news.description: The  Panthers extended a key part of their offense Thursday, reaching a three-year, $35 million deal with receiver Jalen Coker, agent Matt Glose told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
